_comment: DRAFT -- verified: false, confidence: low. Written on 2026-08-06 from a
SINGLE Bailian RAG pass. Nobody has read the source against it.
CADENCE IS WRONG AND THE SCHEMA IS WHY. The policy pays 3600 元 per child
PER YEAR until the child turns 3. models.Cadence is Literal['monthly',
'one_time'] -- there is no annual. Encoding it as monthly 300 元 would put
a figure on the card that the household never receives in any month, so
this uses one_time 3600 元 with duration.kind = fixed_months / months = 12,
which is at least a payment that really happens at a size that is really
correct. It still understates: the money recurs for up to three years and
the results page will not say so. The caveats say so instead.
Fix properly by adding 'annual' to Cadence -- that is a schema change, so
it is not being made inside a draft rule file.
PER-CHILD MULTIPLICATION: fixed 2026-08-07. benefit.amount is a Table over
num_children_under_3 (derived in derive.py), enumerating 1-6 children at
3600 元 each, because Table cannot multiply and a row per count is the only
way to express it. Note the count is children UNDER 3, not num_children --
a household of [1, 5] has two children and one subsidy.
A 7th eligible child returns no_match rather than a wrong number: the card
loses its figure and gains 补贴金额表未覆盖此情况. Deliberate. Extend the
rows if that ever needs to be real.
Eligibility deliberately does NOT encode 申领人须为婴幼儿父母一方或法定监
护人. It is a fact about who fills in the form rather than about the
household, and making it a manual_review clause would route every single
applicant to needs_verification and the program would never produce a
computed result at all. It lives in required_documents instead.
The hukou condition here is the CHILD's 北京市户籍, not the applicant's.
Profile has one hukou_type field for the household, so bj_urban and
bj_rural are both accepted and the distinction is lost. Review this.
name: 育儿补贴
agency: 北京市卫生健康委员会

all_of.note: 婴幼儿须具有北京市户籍（户籍迁入本市的 3 周岁以下婴幼儿自落户日起可申领）
补贴发放至婴幼儿年满 3 周岁止

duration.review: 每孩每年 3600 元，按年申领，发放至年满 3 周岁止

benefit_caveats: ⚠️ 本补贴按年发放（每孩每年 3600 元），发放至婴幼儿年满 3 周岁止，并非只发一次。卡片上标注的「一次性」为展示限制。
2022—2024 年出生的婴幼儿按应补贴月数折算金额，首次申请截止时间已延长至 2026 年 12 月 31 日。
2025 年 1 月 1 日及以后出生的婴幼儿，须在出生当年或次年提出首次申请，并在后续连续两年内续领。
claim_steps: 以家庭为单位，由 1 名申领人（婴幼儿父母一方或法定监护人）提出申请
通过京通小程序 / 北京市政务服务网“育儿补贴申领一件事”线上提交，或到属地卫生健康部门线下办理
审核通过后由财政发放至申领人账户
次年按规定续领，直至婴幼儿年满 3 周岁
required_documents: 证明抚养关系的法定有效文件（收养、监护等情形适用）
notes: 单次 RAG 抽取草稿。cadence 与按孩数累加两处均为已知偏差，见文件顶部注释。文号（京卫家庭〔2025〕14号）与中办国办实施方案的引用在检索结果中出现过串接，须人工核对后录入 manifest。
